newsitem.title: GREECE: DELTA SECURITIES BOSS SHOWS UP AT BROKER TALKS.
newsitem.headline: DELTA SECURITIES BOSS SHOWS UP AT BROKER TALKS.

text.p: Dimitris Argyriadis, charged with fraud and president of the securites firm at the centre of an Athens bourse scandal, showed up at an emergency meeting of the Athens stockbrokers association (SMEHA), brokers said.
Argyriadis, president of Delta Securities, arrived at the meeting and went into talks with brokers' association president Panayiotis Kontalexis.
It was unclear why Argyriadis had shown up suddenly at the meeting.

His firm's attempt to pay the bourse clearing house with bad cheques brought criminal charges of "large-scale, repeated" fraud against Argyriadis and prompted bourse authorities to freeze Delta's assets and accounts last week.
The alleged fraud erupted into a major battle among brokers, many of whom charged that there was a deeper scandal behind the Delta default involving a number of firms.
A row over how to investigate the Delta fraud prompted the 65-member brokers association to refuse to trade, effectively closing the bourse, for the past three days. --Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
